name: anki-review
description: Review Anki cards in a pane while Claude works

ankiconnectApiKey.title: AnkiConnect API key
ankiconnectApiKey.description: Leave empty unless you set an apiKey in AnkiConnect's config.

syncWhenFinished.title: Sync with AnkiWeb when a deck is finished
syncWhenFinished.description: After the last card of a deck, ask Anki to sync so the reviews reach your other devices.

takeKeyboardBack.title: Take the keyboard back after a permission prompt
takeKeyboardBack.description: When a permission prompt takes the keyboard from the review pane, give it back to the pane once the prompt is answered.

showDeveloperDetails.title: Show developer details
showDeveloperDetails.description: Print the mod's memory at the bottom of the pane, for working on the mod. It shows card answers early.
